scope: Complete twelve-second normal-motion portrait stories after font loading, CPU1/CPU4, native/full, desktop DPR1/mobile DPR2. Current reports bind the final source. Historical reports retain the first candidate measurement before the queued reduced-fade fix. Final route/module timing and stress performance work remain open.

reports.scope: Twelve-second C3 portrait input stories including pointer reveals, original 600ms trails, keyboard toggle and Reset. Actual isolated native and complete full Stage CPU-throttled stories at desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2. Fonts are prepared before mounting. First contentful paint and observed readiness are recorded; CDP traces bind paint/layout work and frame gaps. These measurements do not declare final timing gates passed or include public route/module transfer.
